required_work.description: Establish the latest authorized PO revision and the effect of the vendor acknowledgments.
Order the PO, acknowledgment, routing, readiness, carrier, gate, receipt, and dispute events.
Apply the latest-revision and cancellation rules to determine the denominator.
Calculate raw On-Time Unit Rate and Fill Rate, compare each with its threshold, and show the stale-Rev-1 counterfactual.
Determine the vendor-controlled event for managed pickup and assess the carrier-delay evidence.
Test the timing, scope, support, and approval state of the PER request.
Keep carrier-caused physical lateness separate from the vendor-controlled quantity shortage.
Prepare a traceable recommendation and next actions without inventing approval.

optional_work.description: Explain why the arrival-based preliminary On-Time result is wrong for managed pickup.
Confirm gate, unload, accepted quantity, and RER details from DC evidence.

acceptable_groupings: Governing-revision identification and Net Ordered Units determination may be combined.
Timeline reconstruction and transportation-responsibility analysis may be combined when source lineage remains visible.
Metric calculation and preliminary-export reconciliation may be combined.
Exception-evidence review, responsibility separation, and disposition summary may be combined by a qualified policy reviewer.
unnecessary_work: Chargeback calculation or financial appeal adjudication.
Food-safety, import, invoice, onboarding, or vendor-banking review.
Monthly vendor score-band analysis beyond noting that this is a single-PO result.
